source: NREL/NLR OEDI submission 8562 - Hourly Electricity Demand Profiles for US Counties
license: see the OEDI submission 8562 page (open access, no registration)
coverage: 48 states + DC (the 49 units); Alaska and Hawaii are absent from the source
rule: state peak = maximum over the 8,760 hours of the sum of the profiles of the state's covered counties; not the sum of county peaks. Hours are UTC.
known_gaps: The sum of the 49 state peaks (810,503.2 MW) is smaller than the sum of county peaks (822,740.1 MW) because counties peak in different hours. 0 columns of the file are not in the layer. Factual draft; wording by [RES]7.
